name: ConfigImport
syntax: ConfigImport( any path, [string type], [string password], [struct params], [boolean flushExistingData], [string charset] )

params.name: path
params.description: Path to the .CFConfig.json file or the data itself as a Struct.

params.name: type
params.description: Config Context to manipulate, server or web context.

params.name: password
params.description:
Password to access the configuration, depending on the value set for the attribute type. 

If not set Lucee will check in the following places for the password (replace {type} with the actual type chosen for the attribute type).

Environment variable "LUCEE_{type}_ADMIN_PASSWORD" or system property "lucee.{type}.admin.password".

params.name: params
params.description: placeholder parameters to use as actual data for the placeholders inside the configuration, see main description of this function for more details.

params.name: flushExistingData
params.description: if true that existing data get replaced with the given data, if set to false they get updated.

params.name: charset
params.description: charset to use to read the .CFConfig file, if not defined, Lucee will use the default resource charset.
